errors.text: The proposed thermally activated fcc-to-hcp transition has the wrong direction relative to the cited evidence: heating favors hcp-to-fcc transformation, whereas fcc-to-hcp transformation was induced by very high pressure.
The claimed 500–800 K ambient-pressure transition boundary is unsupported by the cited studies and misses the target degradation threshold near 900 K.
The dominant target mechanism is temperature-driven lattice disorder, dislocation-density evolution, and softening rather than conversion into a bulk brittle hcp phase.
The hypothesis substitutes CoCrFeMnNi or AlCoCrFeNi-based behavior for the FeNiCrCoCu coating on Cu without evidence that their phase boundaries or wear mechanisms transfer.
